sentences.en: From an objective viewpoint, his argument was far from rational.
sentences.zh: 从客观的角度来看，他的论点远非理性。

sentences.en: I am looking at the matter from a different viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 我从不同的角度来看待这个问题。

sentences.en: Your own positions are viewpoints that don't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 你自己的立场毫无道理可言。

senses.zh: 观点，意见，角度,视角,<物>视点
